A '''water war''' was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cona/Legends|Cona]] many years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Cona was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world whose surface was devoid of free standing [[Water/Legends|water]]. The only source of water for Cona's [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] inhabitants was the underground gastric pods that were used by Cona's [[Plant/Legends|flora]] to synthesize and store water. Arcona [[Nest (Arcona)|nest]] communities would cultivate plants for their water pods and construct mines to harvest deeper ones. Two [[Grand Nest]]s fought a long and violent war over Cona's scarce water resources. This war increased the thirst of their hive communities and made it unsafe for homesteads to harvest water.<ref name="SWSE" />
